jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.reason: Migration policy at OSF is policy-adjacent and relevant, but this Program Manager role requires substantial regional expertise, established government/multilateral relationships, and a proven track record leading multi-year change initiatives — well beyond the candidate's MSc-stage profile. The role also effectively requires working Spanish for Western Hemisphere stakeholder engagement, which the candidate does not have (hard ineligibility on language).
jobs.location: Mexico City, Mexico or Bogotá, Colombia

jobs.title: Surveyor
jobs.reason: This is a technical engineering inspection role requiring a completed engineering degree in mechanical/plant engineering, knowledge of pressure equipment directives, and ideally certifications as a welding engineer (IWE) or ASME Authorized Inspector. The candidate's IR/policy background is a complete mismatch, and the role requires specialist vocational engineering qualifications they do not hold — hard ineligibility.

jobs.title: Food Safety Auditor / Social Assessor - Global
jobs.reason: Food safety auditing and social compliance assessment for workplace standards is a specialist commercial auditing field unrelated to the candidate's IR/policy/intelligence targets. The role expects prior social auditing experience or APSCA qualification, which the candidate lacks, and is residence-restricted to specific countries.
jobs.location: Home-based (Europe, Caucasus, Central/South America, Africa, Asia — various countries)

jobs.title: Coordinator, Responsible Sourcing
jobs.reason: This is an audit scheduling/coordination role in supply-chain assurance, not policy, intelligence, or research work — it falls outside all three of the candidate's target zones. The role also requires good command of Spanish (oral and written) for client and factory communication, which the candidate does not have, triggering the language hard ineligibility rule.

jobs.title: Contractor
jobs.reason: This is an auditor/assessor contractor role for compliance assessments in Taipei, requiring APSCA auditor qualifications and on-site assessment experience — entirely outside the candidate's IR/policy/research field. The role also likely requires Mandarin for Taipei-based client work, which the candidate does not speak.

jobs.title: Book Reviews Editor - Consultancy
jobs.reason: Field alignment is excellent (International Relations journal at Chatham House), but the role explicitly requires an established scholar with an academic post, a strong publication record, and an extensive professional network across IR academics and policymakers. The candidate, currently pursuing an MSc, does not meet these senior-academic requirements — hard ineligibility on seniority.

jobs.title: Employment Adviser - Andover
jobs.reason: Employment advisory / welfare-to-work case management is a mismatch with the candidate's IR research, policy, and intelligence target zones. The role requires client-facing employment coaching skills rather than research or analytical skills the candidate brings.

jobs.title: Fachhandwerkerin/Fachhandwerker (w/m/d) im Referat Gebäudetechnik
jobs.reason: This is a skilled-trades role requiring a completed German vocational training (Ausbildung) in Mechatronik/Elektromechanik plus several years of experience in elevator/conveyor technology and building services — a hard ineligibility trigger (specific vocational training the candidate lacks). The role has no overlap with the candidate's IR/policy background.
jobs.salary: €3,582.38 gross/month (Experience level 3) + €220 ministerial allowance (TVöD E7 / A7)
